cinematic.bdragon.alpha.2: The blood of the ancient dragons boils…
cinematic.bdragon.alpha.3: The alpha of its race is born.
cinematic.bdragon.alpha.title: ALPHA
codex.bdragon.alpha.awaken.text: At stage V, stand on the ground and right-click with the orb of your race. You turn into your dragon form and the awakening begins, seen in third person: the orb rises, you float into the air, the orb dives into your heart… and the alpha is born. Nothing can hurt you during the awakening. Esc: skip the cinematic.
codex.bdragon.alpha.forest.beam.range: Its range is your render distance: it stops at the edge of the chunks loaded for you (4 chunks of render distance = never further than those 4 chunks). It never touches an unloaded chunk, nor the blocks of a building, nor the protected spawn area.
codex.bdragon.alpha.forest.beam.text: Key %s: a continuous beam of %s s comes out of its mouth, where you look (%s again to stop it). Where it touches natural ground, a forest grows at once and forever: full grown trees, tall grass, flowers and ripe crops. It deals %s damage per second to the monsters, heals %s hearts per second to the players and friendly creatures, and slays the Ender Dragon in one shot.
codex.bdragon.alpha.forest.body.text: Nine hit zones cover its whole body: a blow or an arrow that touches the shell, the forest, the head or a leg really hurts it. Its solid box is the "trunk" of the tortoise (3.6 × 10.8 blocks): Minecraft gives a player a single square box. It needs 11 free blocks above it to transform.
codex.bdragon.alpha.forest.flight.text: Moving forward: front legs stretched forward, hind legs backward, like a jumping horse. Still in the air: clouds gather and swirl under its four paws; if it stays still for 30 seconds (in the air or on the ground, where it then rests on its belly), it slowly pulls its head, legs and tail into its shell (only a look) and comes out at the slightest movement. Going down: the clouds slide down and the tortoise sinks slowly, heavily. When it falls, its clouds catch it (no damage): forward makes it drift, back brakes, sneak drops it.
codex.bdragon.alpha.forest.stats: Health +%s hearts, armour %s, attack +%s, +%s ground speed, nothing pushes it back. It flies slower than the other alphas.
codex.bdragon.alpha.forest.text: A colossal flying turtle carrying a small world of grass and trees on its shell.
codex.bdragon.alpha.forge.text: Offer to the Dragon Altar (right-click with the item) %s alpha scales and 1 Nether Star: the Orb of Power of the race appears above the altar. You can forge as many as you want, for a friend of the same race for example. Sneak + right-click with an empty hand: take the offerings back.
codex.bdragon.alpha.intro: Beyond the legendary stage, a dragon can become the Alpha of its race, forever. What it turns into is for you to discover.
codex.bdragon.alpha.key.text: Key %s (Options > Controls), in dragon form only. Each Alpha has its own ultimate power.
codex.bdragon.alpha.look.text: The alpha is bigger and its aura shines with the colour of its race. In hybrid form, an alpha scale with a golden rim, in the colours of its race, shines on its forehead. The alpha of the Forest changes completely: it becomes the Sylvan Tortoise. The alpha of the Storm becomes the Tempest Dragon. The alpha of the Nether becomes the Demon of the Nether.
codex.bdragon.alpha.nether.flight.text: On the ground it walks on its four limbs, the arm of one side with the leg of the other. In flight it opens its wings and beats them like the dragons, at a steady pace, its legs and tails trailing behind. Still in the air, it stands upright and beats its wings. If it does not move for %s s, it yawns: its mouth opens wide, its head rises a little and turns to its right, like a roaring lion.
codex.bdragon.alpha.nether.power.text: Ultimate: it raises its own Nether out of the ground, under a burning acid rain.
codex.bdragon.alpha.nether.rain: At the same time an acid rain falls and follows it for %s s: every second it burns every creature under it (%s blocks around it) for half a heart, through the armour: %s hearts in all. It and its pets are not hurt. A roof protects from the rain.
codex.bdragon.alpha.nether.text: A winged demon of lava and dark stone, walking on its knuckles like a great ape.
codex.bdragon.alpha.power.hybrid: Hybrid form: punch of %s, +%s ground speed.
codex.bdragon.alpha.power.more: Flight %s faster, lair sense %s blocks, roar every %s s, bigger than any legendary dragon.
codex.bdragon.alpha.power.text: Health +%s hearts (instead of +%s), armor %s (instead of %s), attack +%s (instead of +%s), breath of %s blocks and %s damage, energy %s (instead of %s).
codex.bdragon.alpha.scales.text: Every wild dragon of rank V drops one alpha scale of its race. You need %s of your own race. At stage V, the Challenge Horn shows you the nearest rank V lair of your race.
codex.bdragon.alpha.storm.body.text: Nine hit zones follow its head and its body, rearing, on the ground or in flight: a blow or an arrow that touches it really hurts it. It needs %s free blocks above it to transform.
codex.bdragon.alpha.storm.flight.text: Still on the ground, it rears: the torso straight up, the neck in an S, the head level, the arms out and the body coiled in a spiral; it breathes slowly. Still in the air, a tornado holds it up: the head and the arms at the centre, its body winds around it in a cone that goes down and narrows, and the wind turns around it. On the ground, it moves with its front raised, humps running along its body. In flight, its body follows the path of its head, like the snake of the old games: the tail goes where the head went (in a tight turn the head can cross its tail); a wave runs along its body and it tilts with its path: nose up when it climbs. Diving, it goes straight like an arrow, nose down, the arms swept back. When it moves, its talons grip the clouds that carry it.
codex.bdragon.alpha.storm.power.text: Ultimate: it calls a storm whose lightning hunts down its enemies.
codex.bdragon.alpha.storm.stats: Health +%s hearts, armor %s, attack +%s, +%s ground speed, and it flies at about %s blocks per second (twice as fast when sprinting). Nothing pushes it back.
codex.bdragon.alpha.storm.strikes: %s bolts strike the monsters around it, one after the other (one every %s s, up to %s blocks), %s damage each: 3 bring down the Ender Dragon. Each bolt picks a monster at random, but the one with the most health has the best chance to be hit, and the one that was just hit has little chance to be hit again.
codex.bdragon.alpha.storm.text: An endless serpent of black clouds, cracked with lightning. The fastest creature in the sky.
codex.bdragon.alpha.sunlight.flight.text: On the ground it walks like a horse. In the air it flies like a pegasus: great wing beats, the front legs folded and the hind legs stretched. Its sun turns very slowly. If you stay %s s without moving, your sun spins faster for 10 s, shrinks, turns to stardust, then appears again at once and grows back (and so on every minute).
codex.bdragon.alpha.moonlight.flight.tex: It moves like the Tempest Dragon. In flight there are no clouds: only a breeze of the night wind along its body. Still in the air, a platform shaped like a star carries it.
codex.bdragon.alpha.sunlight.power.text: Ultimate: it hurls its sun like a meteor and brings back the day.
codex.bdragon.alpha.moonlight.power.text: Ultimate: it brings the night and hurls a moon that wipes out everything it hits.
codex.bdragon.alpha.sunlight.text: A golden winged horse crowned with a halo, a small sun floating above its head.
codex.bdragon.alpha.moonlight.text: A long dragon the colour of the night sky, with stars orbiting around its body.
codex.bdragon.become.altar: Place the altar. To offer an ingredient: right-click the altar with the item in hand. Right-click with an empty hand: shows the current quest.
codex.bdragon.become.intro: Four ingredient quests to complete at the Dragon Altar, then the transformation ritual.
codex.bdragon.become.quest3: Offer an elemental essence (chapter The essences). The first essence offered decides your race, forever!
codex.bdragon.become.quest4: Your race demands its offerings: see its page in the chapter The 11 races.
codex.bdragon.become.ritual.text: When everything is offered, use the altar with an empty hand: lightning strikes and you become a Hatchling of your race.
codex.bdragon.contents.hint: Click a chapter to open it.
codex.bdragon.essences.intro: Shapeless recipe at the crafting table: the 4 ingredients of the element + 1 glass bottle. Wild dragons also drop them.
codex.bdragon.forms.dragon: Your true form: all your power, flight and full strength. Too big to dig: switch to the hybrid form to mine.
codex.bdragon.forms.hybrid: Half human, half dragon, with the horns, wings and tail of your race. Your powers at %s, the fastest form on the ground, it glides, and its bare claws dig like a pickaxe with Silk Touch.
codex.bdragon.forms.intro: After the ritual there is no way back to the human body: the %s key switches between your two forms.
codex.bdragon.items.alpha_orb: Forged at the altar. Right-click: alpha.
codex.bdragon.items.alpha_orb.title: Orbs of Power
codex.bdragon.items.alpha_scale: Rank V: one per dragon, of its race.
codex.bdragon.items.alpha_scale.title: Alpha scales
codex.bdragon.items.altar: The heart of the quests and of the ritual (recipe in the chapter Becoming a dragon).
codex.bdragon.items.codex: Given on your first arrival in the world. Shortcut: %s.
codex.bdragon.items.horn: Blow into it: a young dragon (rank I-II) answers your call, or it reveals the nearest nest of the rank you need.
codex.bdragon.lairs.behaviour.text: The dragon appears when you approach its nest and defends it. If you flee too far, it goes home. Once defeated, another dragon takes the nest after %s days.
codex.bdragon.lairs.intro: Wild dragons live in nests, out in the open like villages, in the biomes of their element.
codex.bdragon.lairs.loot.text: The dragon drops its scales, its bones and sometimes the essence of its race. A chest waits in each nest, richer with the rank.
codex.bdragon.lairs.map.text: With JourneyMap, the lairs you discovered and those your dragon instinct senses are shown on the minimap and the big map, with the race and the rank (I to V). The Challenge Horn reveals the nearest lair of the rank you need.
codex.bdragon.lairs.none: None yet. Explore, or blow a Challenge Horn.
codex.bdragon.lairs.ranks.text: Only dragons of rank III to V have a nest, and the farther from the spawn, the stronger they are. Rank I and II dragons answer the Challenge Horn instead.
codex.bdragon.powers.alpha.text: Key %s, for the alpha in dragon form (recharge %s s, it goes on in hybrid form). See the chapter The Alpha.
codex.bdragon.powers.breath.text: Hold %s. The breath of your race hits everything in front of you and uses your energy, which comes back by itself.
codex.bdragon.powers.codex.text: %s opens it at any time, even when it is not in your hand.
codex.bdragon.powers.fly.text: In dragon form, from stage II: double jump to take off, jump and sneak to go up and down. At stage II, the "Wings" bar empties quickly.
codex.bdragon.powers.form.text: %s: Hybrid ⇄ Dragon. See the chapter The 2 forms.
codex.bdragon.powers.glide.text: In dragon or hybrid form, when you fall (tired wings, flight stopped, jump from a cliff), your wings open: you glide instead of crashing. The mouse steers. The dive: hold Forward (or look a little down) to dive and speed up, without looking under your feet. Left / right: drift sideways. Back: brake. Look up: gain height. Sneak: fold your wings and drop.
codex.bdragon.powers.ground.text: At stage V, the ground transforms under your feet (magma for fire, snow for ice...), like with Frost Walker boots. The blocks go back to normal after a few seconds and cannot be mined.
codex.bdragon.powers.passive.text: Each race has its permanent powers (see its page). They work in both forms.
codex.bdragon.powers.roar.text: %s, from stage III: pushes and hits everything around you. Costs %s energy, then %s s of cooldown.
codex.bdragon.progress.alpha: You are the Alpha of your race!
codex.bdragon.progress.alpha_next: Next step: the Alpha (chapter The Alpha).
codex.bdragon.progress.altar: Use the items on the altar to offer them.
codex.bdragon.progress.essence: Offer one of these essences to the altar. The first one offered chooses your race forever!
codex.bdragon.progress.human: You are still human. Complete the quests of the Dragon Altar to transform.
codex.bdragon.progress.ritual.text: All quests are complete. Use the Dragon Altar with an empty hand to become a %s.
codex.bdragon.races.intro: Each race draws its body, breath and powers from its element. You can only choose one, forever.
codex.bdragon.stages.alpha: After stage V: the Alpha (next chapter).
codex.bdragon.stages.fly.limited: yes, but the wings get tired
codex.bdragon.stages.intro: To evolve you need two things: enough power AND having defeated a wild dragon of the rank of the next stage. The evolution is then automatic.
codex.bdragon.stages.power: Power: kill monsters (about max health ÷ 10) and above all wild dragons (40 × rank², so 1000 for a rank V).
codex.bdragon.stages.title: Stage %s · %s
codex.bdragon.tips.text:
• Start with quests 1 and 2: bones, leather, gold, diamonds...
• Choose your essence well: you can never change race.
• For your first challenges, blow the Challenge Horn: a young dragon comes to you.
• In hybrid form you run faster and dig with bare hands (Silk Touch).
• Jump off a cliff in dragon or hybrid form: you glide without getting hurt.
• An empty village may hide a Dragon Altar at its centre.
dragon_stage.bdragon.elder.feature: second pair of curved horns, huge wings, back spikes, aura
dragon_stage.bdragon.hatchling.feature: big head, budding horns, tiny wings
dragon_stage.bdragon.juvenile.feature: growing horns, neck crest, first flights
dragon_stage.bdragon.legendary.feature: the crown of its race, its full look, the ground transforms
dragon_type.bdragon.end.anatomy: The classic void dragon: scales split by purple rifts dotted with stars, dark horns, a crown and a double tail at stage V.
dragon_type.bdragon.end.desc: Come from the void between the stars, it bends space.
dragon_type.bdragon.end.powers:
• No fall damage.
• Stage III: teleports away from 30% of projectiles.
• Stage IV: Strength and regeneration in the End.
• Breath: levitation.
dragon_type.bdragon.fire.anatomy: Body of obsidian and coal cracked with lava, black wings with lava membranes. Boiling lava bubbles swell and burst on its back (stage II+), a crest of flames runs along its spine (stage III+) and its body throws sparks and smoke. A single tail, with a flame burning at its end from stage II, growing with it.
dragon_type.bdragon.fire.desc: A living volcano: black obsidian cracked with lava.
dragon_type.bdragon.fire.powers:
• Immune to fire and lava.
• Stage III: Strength in the Nether.
• Stage IV: sets attackers on fire.
• Breath: burning flames.
dragon_type.bdragon.forest.anatomy: A log body covered with tufts of moss, flowers (stage II+) and red and brown mushrooms (stage III+). Its horns are leafy branches: thin shoots from stage I, big branches from stage III. Its tail is a thick bundle of eight leafy lianas.
dragon_type.bdragon.forest.desc: Nature itself: a log body, branches and lianas.
dragon_type.bdragon.forest.powers:
• Never poisoned.
• Regeneration in the sun (stronger at stage IV).
• Stage III: hardly ever hungry.
• Stage IV: poisons attackers.
• Breath: poisonous spores.
• Alpha: the Sylvan Tortoise and its Beam of Life.
dragon_type.bdragon.ice.anatomy: Scales crossed by sparkling frost veins. Frost horns, a double tail at stage V and a real crown of ice crystals joining its four horns.
dragon_type.bdragon.ice.desc: The breath of the frozen peaks, cold and relentless.
dragon_type.bdragon.ice.powers:
• Immune to freezing.
• In the cold: Speed (stage II), Resistance (stage III).
• Stage IV: slows attackers.
• Breath: freezing, slowing frost.
dragon_type.bdragon.moonlight.anatomy: The night dragon: hide and wings dotted with stars, a moonstone shines on its forehead (stage II+) and a silver crescent moon rises on its head (stage III+, growing until stage V). Pale horns and a double tail at stage V.
dragon_type.bdragon.moonlight.desc: A creature of the night, its strength grows under the moon.
dragon_type.bdragon.moonlight.powers:
• Night vision.
• At night: Speed, Strength (stage III), invisible when sneaking (stage IV).
• Breath: lunar frost, stronger at night.
dragon_type.bdragon.nether.anatomy: Nether fungi grow all over its body like warts. Two devil horns. Its lower jaw sticks out past the upper one, with two saber teeth rising from it. Three thin, sharp tails (2 at stage III, 3 at stage V), each ending with a trident.
dragon_type.bdragon.nether.desc: Forged in the soul flames of the underworld.
dragon_type.bdragon.nether.powers:
• Immune to fire and lava.
• Stage III: Strength in the Nether (Strength II at stage V).
• Stage IV: sets attackers on fire.
• Breath: soul flames and Wither.
dragon_type.bdragon.storm.anatomy: A long storm serpent: slim body, long neck, long waving tail. Storm-grey scales crossed by glowing lightning, long electric whiskers, storm clouds on its back and at the end of its tail (stage II+). Its horns are lightning bolts: two from stage I, two big ones at stage IV, a lightning crest at stage V.
dragon_type.bdragon.storm.desc: A serpent of the thunderclouds, lightning runs under its scales.
dragon_type.bdragon.storm.powers:
• Immune to lightning.
• Speed (II from stage III), Strength II during thunderstorms (and during its alpha Storm).
• Stage IV: shocks attackers.
• Breath: lightning.
• Alpha: the Tempest Dragon and its Storm.
dragon_type.bdragon.sunlight.anatomy: One single golden colour, no horn at all. Its wings are made of blades of light: each finger carries a long glowing sword. A sword of light ends its tail (stage II+). A halo of light floats above its head (from stage III). A single tail.
dragon_type.bdragon.sunlight.desc: A fragment of the sun crowned with a halo, bane of the undead.
dragon_type.bdragon.sunlight.powers:
• Regeneration in daylight.
• Stage IV: burns the undead around it.
• Breath: sun rays, double damage to the undead.
dragon_type.bdragon.terra.anatomy: Chubby and massive, its hide is cracked rock dotted with gold nuggets. Rock plates cover its back (one more at each stage) and gold crystals grow out of them from stage III. A single horn, on its nose. One huge tail ending with a warty rock club. Two pairs of wings from stage III.
dragon_type.bdragon.terra.desc: Massive as the mountain, its golden runes shine in the rock.
dragon_type.bdragon.terra.powers:
• Very hard to knock back.
• Stage II: Haste (fast mining), II at stage IV.
• Stage IV: Resistance.
• Breath: blinding sandstorm.
dragon_type.bdragon.water.anatomy: A long sea serpent: slim body, long neck, long waving tail. Abyssal blue-green scales dotted with glowing spots, needle teeth (stage II+), a row of fins on its back. Two big horns covered with sea moss, fins as ears and a fin at the end of its tail.
dragon_type.bdragon.water.desc: A serpent of the abyss whose scales glow in the dark.
dragon_type.bdragon.water.powers:
• Breathes underwater, never drowns.
• Stage II: Dolphin's Grace.
• Stage III: regeneration in water and rain.
• Breath: pushing torrent, double damage to fire creatures.
dragon_type.bdragon.wither.anatomy: Dark scales crossed by blue soul veins. A crown of small black skulls with blue eyes grows on its head: one skull at stage III, three at stage IV, five at stage V. A single tail made only of bones: a column of vertebrae.
dragon_type.bdragon.wither.desc: A skeleton animated by souls, it withers all it touches.
dragon_type.bdragon.wither.powers:
• Never withered.
• Stage III: life steal (15% of the damage).
• Stage IV: withers attackers.
• Breath: withering souls.
item.bdragon.alpha_orb.tooltip_1: Awakens the alpha of a legendary %s.
item.bdragon.alpha_orb.tooltip_2: Right-click, standing on the ground: forever.
item.bdragon.alpha_scale.tooltip_2: %s scales + 1 Nether Star at the altar = the orb.
item.bdragon.challenge_horn.tooltip_2: of a dragon of the rank you need.
item.bdragon.dragon_grimoire.tooltip: Everything to become a dragon. Key [G]
item.bdragon.essence.tooltip: Offer it to the altar (quest 3). Final choice!
message.bdragon.alpha.bonus: Bigger and stronger than any legendary dragon: more health, armor, attack, breath, energy and flight speed.
message.bdragon.alpha.hint_2: Offer here %s alpha scales (rank V %s) and 1 Nether Star: the Orb of Power.
message.bdragon.alpha.look: Your body grew, your aura shines with the colour of your race and, in hybrid form, the alpha scale shines on your forehead.
message.bdragon.alpha.look.forest: You became the Sylvan Tortoise: 17 × 12 × 12 blocks, with a small plains biome on your shell. In hybrid form, the alpha scale shines on your forehead.
message.bdragon.alpha.look.nether: You became the Demon of the Nether: a red winged demon with lava skin, walking raised like a gorilla. In hybrid form, the alpha scale shines on your forehead.
message.bdragon.alpha.look.storm: You became the Tempest Dragon: a long storm serpent cracked with lightning. Still in the air, a tornado holds you up; in flight, a wave runs along your body and your talons grip the clouds: you are the fastest alpha. In hybrid form, the alpha scale shines on your forehead.
message.bdragon.alpha.look.sunlight: You became the Sun Steed: a golden winged horse with an angel halo and a miniature sun above its head. In the hybrid form, the alpha scale shines on your forehead.
message.bdragon.alpha.look.moonlight: You became the Moon Dragon: a long dragon coloured like the night sky, with the head of an Ender Dragon, a crescent moon on its head and stars in orbit around you. In the hybrid form, the alpha scale shines on your forehead.
message.bdragon.alpha.power: Key %s: alpha power (dragon form, recharge %s s).
message.bdragon.alpha.power.forest: Your power: the Beam of Life (6 s). It grows a forest where it touches the ground, heals your allies, burns the monsters and slays the Ender Dragon in one shot.
message.bdragon.alpha.power.nether: Your power: the Territory (recharge 3 min). After an incantation of 5 s, your Nether territory rises out of the ground around you, with peaks up to the height 145, and an acid rain follows you for 30 s: it burns everything under it for half a heart per second, through the armour. It does nothing to you.
message.bdragon.alpha.power.storm: Your power: the Storm (1 min, recharge 3 min). You roar, lightning falls everywhere around you and 10 bolts strike the monsters, one after the other (3 are enough to bring down the Ender Dragon). Lightning does nothing to you.
message.bdragon.alpha.power.sunlight: Your power: the Sun (recharge 45 s). You rear up and throw your sun where you aim: it explodes at the first obstacle and wipes out everything but the bedrock in a ball of 10 blocks of radius. It grows back during the recharge.
message.bdragon.alpha.power.moonlight: Your power: the Moon (recharge 45 s). Your roar brings the night, then you throw a moon where you aim: it explodes at the first obstacle and wipes out everything but the bedrock in a ball of 10 blocks of radius.
message.bdragon.alpha_power.dragon_only: The alpha power only works in dragon form.
message.bdragon.alpha_power.ender_dragon: ✦ %s slew the Ender Dragon with a single Beam of Life!
message.bdragon.alpha_power.life_beam: Beam of Life! (B to stop it)
message.bdragon.alpha_power.locked: Become the alpha of your race to awaken this power.
message.bdragon.alpha_power.wave: Alpha wave! (temporary power, until the one of your race)
message.bdragon.alpha_power.sun.day: The Sun Steed drives the night away: the day rises!
message.bdragon.codex_given_2:
Open it with %s:
everything you need to know is in it.
message.bdragon.forge.done: ✦ The Orb of Power of the %s is born!
message.bdragon.forge.scales_full: The altar already has the scales of the %s.
message.bdragon.forge.star_full: The altar already has its Nether Star.
message.bdragon.forge.take_hint: Sneak + right-click with an empty hand: take the offerings back.
message.bdragon.forge.taken: You take the offerings of the orb back.
message.bdragon.forge.use: Take it, land on the ground and right-click with it: the awakening of the alpha begins.
message.bdragon.help.glide:
• Glide: automatic when falling,
   forward = dive, sneak = stop
message.bdragon.horn_found_3: x %s, z %s (added to your map and codex)
message.bdragon.horn_nothing:
No lair of rank %s or more
within 6,000 blocks.
message.bdragon.horn_nothing_alpha:
No rank V %s lair
within 8,000 blocks. Try the Nether or the End.
message.bdragon.max_stage:
You reached the peak
of draconic power.
message.bdragon.need_challenge_1: Your power is enough to evolve...
message.bdragon.need_challenge_2: ...but you must defeat a rank %s dragon.
message.bdragon.need_challenge_3:
Find a lair (map, codex)
or blow a Challenge Horn.
message.bdragon.need_essence: The altar awaits an elemental essence.
message.bdragon.not_needed: The altar does not need this item.
message.bdragon.orb.already: You already are the alpha of your race.
message.bdragon.orb.ground: Land on the ground for the awakening of the alpha.
message.bdragon.orb.need_legendary: You must be a %s dragon (stage V).
message.bdragon.orb.not_dragon: Only a dragon can absorb this orb.
message.bdragon.orb.start: The Orb of Power rises from your claws…
message.bdragon.ritual_ready:
Everything is ready!
Use the altar with an empty hand
to perform the transformation ritual.
message.bdragon.roar_locked: The roar unlocks at stage III.
message.bdragon.serpent.no_room: Not enough room: the Tempest Dragon needs 6 blocks of height. Go outside.
message.bdragon.serpent.stuck: The Tempest Dragon has no room here: you take back your hybrid form (H to become the dragon again, outside).
message.bdragon.tortoise.no_room: Not enough room: the Sylvan Tortoise is 12 blocks high. Go outside.
message.bdragon.tortoise.stuck: The Sylvan Tortoise has no room here: you take back your hybrid form (H to become the tortoise again, outside).
message.bdragon.type_chosen:
Your fate is sealed:
you will become a %s.
message.bdragon.wings_tired: Your wings are exhausted: you glide.
message.bdragon.steed.no_room: Not enough room: the Sun Steed needs 10 blocks of height. Go outside.
message.bdragon.moon.no_room: Not enough room: the Moon Dragon needs 6 blocks of height. Go outside.
message.bdragon.steed.stuck: The Sun Steed has no room here: you take back your hybrid form (H to become the steed again, outside).
message.bdragon.moon.stuck: The Moon Dragon has no room here: you take back your hybrid form (H to become the dragon again, outside).
museum.bdragon.built: The Bdragon museum is built: follow the path to the south!
museum.bdragon.button.tooltip: Creates the museum world in one click: flat world, creative, commands on. The museum is built when it opens.
museum.bdragon.panel.alpha.text:
At stage V: 4 alpha scales of your race (dropped by the rank V dragons) + 1 Nether Star, offered to the altar = the Orb of Power.
Right-click with the orb, on the ground: the awakening of the alpha.
Key B: alpha power (45 s). Forest: Beam of Life. Storm: the Storm (3 min).
Buttons: the awakening of your race, the Sylvan Tortoise or the Tempest Dragon.
museum.bdragon.panel.alpha.title: The Alpha
museum.bdragon.panel.arena.text:
Press a button on the right: a wild dragon appears in the middle of the arena. Hit it to start (rank IV-V: it attacks by itself).
Defeating it wins the challenge of its rank to evolve.
museum.bdragon.panel.arena.title: The challenge arena
museum.bdragon.panel.evolution.text: Every stage adds a clearly visible feature: here boiling lava bubbles (II), a crest of flames on the spine (III) and a tail flame that grows. At stage V, the ground turns to magma under the feet of the Fire Dragon.
museum.bdragon.panel.evolution.title: The evolution
museum.bdragon.panel.forms.text:
Hybrid: horns, wings and tail, powers at 70%, hits hard, the fastest on the ground, it glides. With an empty hand its claws dig (Silk Touch).
Dragon: 100% of the powers, flies from stage II, but cannot dig.
museum.bdragon.panel.forms.title: The 2 forms · key H
museum.bdragon.panel.lairs.text:
In a normal world, each race lives in rare lairs in its biomes; the rank grows with the distance to the spawn.
Here (flat world), 3 demo lairs are waiting for you: see the signs.
museum.bdragon.panel.lairs.title: The lairs
museum.bdragon.panel.powers.text:
R (hold): breath · V: roar (stage III).
Gliding: jump off the tower in dragon or hybrid form. Hold Forward to dive and speed up, sneak to stop.
Killing monsters gives power.
museum.bdragon.panel.powers.title: Your powers
museum.bdragon.panel.ritual.text:
1. Take the ingredients from the chests.
2. Right-click the altar with each ingredient.
3. Quest 3: the first essence offered chooses your race!
4. Everything offered? Right-click with an empty hand: transformation.
museum.bdragon.panel.ritual.title: The ritual
museum.bdragon.panel.shortcut.text: Press a button to become a Hatchling of that race right away. The last button makes you human again.
museum.bdragon.panel.shortcut.title: Shortcut
museum.bdragon.panel.stages.text:
To evolve you need enough power AND to have defeated a wild dragon of the rank of the next stage.
These buttons make you evolve right away.
museum.bdragon.panel.stages.title: The 5 stages
museum.bdragon.panel.step1.text:
Left: the real ritual (chests + altar).
Right: the shortcut, one button per race.
museum.bdragon.panel.step1.title: Step 1 · Becoming a dragon
museum.bdragon.panel.step2.text:
Left: the 2 forms (key H) and the claw wall.
Right: jump straight to a stage.
museum.bdragon.panel.step2.title: Step 2 · Forms and stages
museum.bdragon.panel.step3.text:
Left: try your powers.
Right: the 5 stages of the Fire Dragon.
museum.bdragon.panel.step3.title: Step 3 · Powers and evolution
museum.bdragon.panel.step4.text: Each race has its own body (horns, tail, wings...), lives in its biomes and keeps its style: particles, breath, powers and legendary ground.
museum.bdragon.panel.step4.title: Step 4 · The 11 races
museum.bdragon.panel.step5.text:
Left: the lairs and the map.
Right: the arena buttons. Straight ahead: the arena.
museum.bdragon.panel.step5.title: Step 5 · Lairs and fights
museum.bdragon.panel.welcome.text:
Follow the path to the south: every step has its signs and buttons.
Your Codex (key G) explains everything in detail.
museum.bdragon.panel.welcome.title: Bdragon Museum
quest.bdragon.1.lore: The ancient dragons rest under the earth. Gather their remains and the gold that lay with them.
quest.bdragon.1.title: The Ancient Bones
quest.bdragon.2.lore: No dragon awakens without a hoard worthy of it.
quest.bdragon.2.title: The Dragon's Hoard
quest.bdragon.3.lore: Choose your element: the first essence offered to the altar decides your race... forever.
quest.bdragon.3.title: The Elemental Essence
quest.bdragon.4.lore: Your element demands its offerings. Bring them to the altar to complete the ritual.
quest.bdragon.4.title: The Offerings
message.bdragon.alpha_power.moon.night: The Moon Dragon roars: the night falls!
codex.bdragon.alpha.others: The other races will awaken their Alpha in future updates.
codex.bdragon.alpha.forest.power.text: Ultimate: a beam of life that makes the land bloom, heals allies and burns enemies.
